## AdminSettings component
- **Status:** Optional
- **Type:** Factory Binding `Injects.AdminSettingsFactory` > `Injects.AdminSettings`

### Description
Designed to encapsulate all the settings loaded from the Admin Panel. Loading via the @arcade-client/games-list package using the engineConfig items GamesListGameName, CoreAssetIdentifier and SkinAssetIdentifier to access that data.

By default holds:
- assetVersion as IAssetVersion
- errorStringsVersion as string
- settingsStringsVersion as string

### Basic Extension
```ts
import { BaseAdminSettings, gamesList } from '@arcade-client/base-package';

export class AdminSettingsEx extends BaseAdminSettings {
    public static get Instance(): AdminSettingsEx { return this._instance || (this._instance = new AdminSettingsEx()); }
    protected static _instance: AdminSettingsEx;

    private _showDebugMenu: boolean = false;

    public get showDebugMenu(): boolean { return this._showDebugMenu; }

    protected constructor() { super(); }

    public async initialise(): Promise<void> {
        await super.initialise();
        this._showDebugMenu = JSON.parse(gamesList.getSkinSetting('showDebugMenu', 'false'));
    }
}
```
